title: Largest island after one flip
pattern: label components, then try each water cell
statement: An n × n grid of 0/1. You may change at most one 0 into a 1. Return the size of the largest island (4-directionally connected 1s) you can get. n ≤ 300.

solution.explanation: Flood-filling again for each flipped cell would be O(n⁴). Instead label every island once (id → size), then for each water cell sum the sizes of the distinct neighbouring ids plus one. Deduplicating neighbour ids (an island touching the cell from two sides) is the classic bug; the all-land grid is the edge case.
